metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at nothing and Valorant said ‘Sure, take it and confuse them’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill while daydreaming?
Enemy probably wondering if I hacked.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still hands out freebies.
Valorant logic doing stand-up comedy again.

Tap if your best kills feel like total accidents!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
